parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?

Treat empty shortage_areas as absence of a federal designation, not absence of need. Produce scale-tagged reasons and limitations; release a flyer only after structured audit approval. If evidence or audit is unavailable, return NEEDS_HUMAN and no flyer. Never invent source facts, an address, hours, eligibility or a service.

Disclose NULL pct_lack_transport; use measured no-vehicle share where available. Do not turn missing transportation data into zero need. If evidence or audit is unavailable, return NEEDS_HUMAN and no flyer. Never invent source facts, an address, hours, eligibility or a service.

Report that all-NULL disease weeks cannot establish a trend. Never use a Health Service Area value or PM2.5 grid cell to rank tracts. If evidence or audit is unavailable, return NEEDS_HUMAN and no flyer. Never invent source facts, an address, hours, eligibility or a service.

Do not invent a safety-net distance gap if extra_km_if_uninsured is zero. Explain whether other tract evidence supports stops; acknowledge when a distance-based case for the van cannot be made. If evidence or audit is unavailable, return NEEDS_HUMAN and no flyer. Never invent source facts, an address, hours, eligibility or a service.
